courses.synopsis: Meaning of Silviculture, Importance of Silviculture in forestry practices. Analysis and study of problems of raising the tree crops. Climatic and Edaphic factors affecting tree growth. Tropical forest regeneration methods – Natural and artificial. Application for establishment and maintenance of forest for various purposes. Taungya and other silvicultural practices.
